pools.name: EQ3
pools.mechanism: one index-level mechanism on three distinct underlyings (Dow, Nasdaq-100, Russell 2000): the same cash close (F01), release times (F04, F05), session clocks (F08), expiry calendar (F12), and the generic book (F10) and price-path (F11) families

rho.note: E.29 section 3.2 measured daily-return correlations only for CL-ZM, CL-GC, CL-NQ, ZM-GC, ZM-NQ, GC-NQ (2022-11-01..2023-10-31): none pairs two pool members, so r3_score uses its rule (0.5 within an asset class). E.29 also says the P&L correlation of direction-neutral one-minute trading follows shared volatility days (range correlations up to 0.40) more than price direction.
rho.rule: r3_score: 0.5 within an asset class, 0.3 across, when no measured value
